$description: Mume design tokens. Source of truth for web, Swift and Kotlin. Nobody hand-writes a hex value in a view (DD-11).

kelp.$description: Brand accent. Deliberately identical to the 'passed' state (DD-04).

paper.$description: Warm off-white. Not #FFF — pure white glares on OLED at night.

inkFaint.$description: Solved for 4.5:1 on paper, surface, surfaceSunk AND kelpTint. Was #8B918F = 3.05:1.

focus.$description: Focus ring. 9.26 on paper, 8.49 on surfaceSunk. Compose desktop's default indication draws hover and focus as the SAME black 10% rectangle, so focus must be an outline and hover a fill or a keyboard user cannot locate focus while a mouse is on screen.

trackMuted.$description: Score-gauge track only. 3.10 vs paper -- clears 1.4.11 for a graphical object. Deliberately not hairline (1.26:1), which would have to coarsen every divider in the app to fix one arc.

paper.$description: Near-black, warm-shifted. A first-class theme, not an inversion (gate checklist).

inkFaint.$description: 4.91 paper / 4.53 surface / 4.74 sunk. Deliberately NOT the 6.3:1 value a pure contrast solve gives -- that lands on top of inkMuted 6.78 and erases the ink hierarchy.

kelpTint.$description: Dark counterpart of brand.kelpTint. Was missing: Theme.kt aliased it to dark.surface, so the ledger reconciliation panel drew surface-on-surface and did not exist in dark mode. 7.30:1 with passOnDark.

severity.$description: DD-03. Severity is a LABEL first, a WEIGHT second, and a COLOUR third. Measured 2026-08-29 on all four light and three dark backgrounds: every value clears 4.5:1. The earlier version of this line asserted that without having measured it, and was false for notChecked (3.05:1 on paper, 2.79:1 on surfaceSunk) -- the token carrying the null contract was the one failing token in the file. In dark mode the ramp is NOT separable under dichromacy; label and glyph carry severity there and colour is the third channel only, per DD-03.

notChecked.label: NOT CHECKABLE
notChecked.$description: Carries the null contract, so it is held to body-text contrast on every surface it can land on: 5.03 paper / 5.30 surface / 4.61 surfaceSunk / 4.56 kelpTint, and 4.91 / 4.53 / 4.74 on dark. Was #8B918F/#6B726F, which failed all seven.

grade.$description: Grade bands mirror ScoringPolicy.gradeThresholds exactly. Changing one without the other is a spec break.

type.$description: DD-09. Native faces per platform; the SCALE is shared. 1.200 minor third.

desktopDisplay.value: Segoe UI Variable Display, SF Pro Display, Inter, sans-serif
desktopDisplay.$description: Windows ships two optical sizes and binds the Text cut by default, so an 82sp numeral was being drawn in a face cut for 12sp.

desktopBody.value: Segoe UI Variable Text, SF Pro Text, Inter, sans-serif

desktopMono.value: Cascadia Mono, Consolas, JetBrains Mono, monospace
desktopMono.$description: The ledger column. DD-06 asks the user to add it up; proportional digits do not align.

body.$description: Finding body text never goes below this (DD-09).

score.$description: The score numeral. Tabular figures, -0.03em tracking.

scoreDesktop.$description: score x 1.2, one rung up the same minor third. The desktop gauge shrinks while the numeral grows -- that is how DD-05 (numeral primary, arc secondary) becomes measurable rather than asserted.

measure.$description: Max line length for finding detail text.

radius.$description: Concentric: an inner radius is always outer minus the shell padding, so curves stay parallel.

shellPad.$description: The double-bezel gap. core == shell - shellPad and md == lg - shellPad, so the concentric claim in this group is checkable rather than asserted.

elevationCompose.$description: Compose form of `elevation`. Modifier.shadow(dp, shape, clip=false, ambientColor, spotColor). Surface(shadowElevation=) draws a tight grey Material shadow, which is the harsh drop shadow DD-13 rejects, so the ambient/spot pair is given explicitly. Alphas are the CSS alphas; the dp is the CSS blur/2.2. On DARK these are set to fully transparent -- a shadow is invisible on #0C0E0D at any alpha, and dark separates planes by luminance plus a top highlight instead.

elevation.$description: Soft, highly diffused ambient shadows only. No harsh dark drop shadows.

motion.$description: DD-10. One spring. Everything has a Reduce Motion path.

target.$description: Minimum interactive size. Enforced by the gate checklist.
